name: IMREPO
description: Browse, manage and inspect OCI / Harbor container registries: project and namespace navigation, tag rename and delete, layer analysis, Trivy CVE reports, overview charts and multi-arch breakdowns.
releaseNotes: Fixes the region-dropdown install error (issue #5). Adds private AWS ECR browsing via DescribeRepositories and the AWS credential chain, image archive upload/download (.tar/.tar.gz), Docker Registry v2 projects, overview charts and one badge per architecture. Repository moved to github.com/LeavingRain/dbx-plugin-imrepo. Security note: the last connection password / CLI secret is cached base64-encoded (encoding, not encryption) in credentials.json under the plugin data directory; prefer least-privilege robot accounts or read-only tokens, and delete the file when no longer needed.
